name: Fish wishing festival
summary: The fish-wishing festival runs from the first lunar month through the sixth, in coastal and lagoon villages, at the tomb where the whale is worshipped. The page names a rite, then games: greeting the god, a royal honor, a funeral oration, hò bá trạo, boat racing, and swinging coracles. It says the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism recognized the province’s festival as national intangible heritage. A single city address was not printed. The solar dates move. Check on arrival. No fee was printed.
when: First through sixth lunar month, every year. Solar dates: check on arrival.
